# Log-test context completion still uses mark_test_end after the all-tests wrapper is removed

1940 removes mark_all_tests_run, which ended contexts and logged All finished. The current mark_test_end still pops contexts down to a requested depth and emits per-context completion text; mark_sub_test_end closes only a nested context. Use these surviving local context contracts when reading older async-test logging. Their presence does not establish an entire test suite passed or every caller closes a context. This is static source and test-code inspection. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline and inline discussion remain pending; source landing does not prove approval of a proposed manual rule.

Scope: mail test logging.
